The '''Council of Chieftains''' was a body comprised of the hereditary [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]] of the [[Eklaad]] tribes on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]]. They met to settle disputes between the tribes and plan joint activities. The Council of Chieftains had not been convened since the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] arrived on Sirpar and established a multitude of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] training facilities.
